desc:
Build your own room and roleplay life in the Circus in this wonderful and imaginative fan game!
A fun and cozy place to Roleplay and Explore. No AI or other annoying interruptions, just pure roleplay bliss.
With over 20 locations, almost the entire world of TADC is realized in just one single game!

-Halloween update is out, more details in group.
-New icon by Player(123bloxrock)
-Huge Tent Update is out!
-Make custom coffee at the Cafe!
-130+ new accessories!
-Ribbit and Kaufmo plushies for dorm room building

-Private servers get full free admin

👉Game features👈
🎪Accurate Circus Tent Layout +20 other locations🎪
✨Customizable Morphs With Tons of Options✨
🚪Explore 11 Character Rooms +24 Claimable Rooms🚪
🕹️Plushie Claw Machines and Glonks Bowling Alley🎳
🎢The Grounds with Coaster, Boats, and More!🎡

👍more coming soon👍

Credits can be found in the title screen of the game.
